answer_1.quote: We therefore provide in Section 4 the first such human baseline, for American Sign Language (ASL) to English translation on the How2Sign dataset ...
answer_1.outputs: English text translations of ASL video clips

answer_2.quote: Following prior works that evaluate on How2Sign, we report BLEU and BLEURT as our quantitative metrics.

answer_4.quote: Our annotators were the two middle authors, who are Deaf signers ... Each annotator spent several hours performing the translations and ratings ... we also ask the annotators to describe how well they understood the sentence in isolation vs. after seeing additional context, and to rate the naturalness of the signing on a scale from 0-2.
answer_4.guideline: Annotators translated each clip, indicated how well they understood the sentence in isolation (not at all, somewhat, mostly, completely), and rated the naturalness of the signing on a 0‑2 scale.
